summary: Full backend + frontend regression of reconstructed AVA Volei Analytics. 51/52 pytest cases pass (1 skipped — alternate AI test when 502). Smoke-tested all key pages (/, /galeria, /atletas, /relatorios, /ia, /configuracoes), athlete creation with new external_id field (data-testid=athlete-external-id) via UI, gallery search/filter, navigation into /analisar/:id with video player + quick-mark bar + point-nos/point-adv, and AI /api/ai/analyze returning a grounded Portuguese answer via Claude. New integration layer (/api/integration/status|pull-athletes|push-analyses) behaves as no-op with enabled:false/mode:local as spec'd.

issues: Recharts warning: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — chart renders inside a hidden/zero-size container on initial mount. Non-blocking but worth guarding with minWidth/minHeight.

action_items: Optional: wrap Recharts ResponsiveContainer in a sized parent on /relatorios to silence width/height=-1 warnings when tab mounts hidden.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1200 lines — consider splitting routers (videos, actions, rallies, ai, stats) into modules for maintainability.
integration_layer.py creates its own AsyncIOMotorClient (duplicates Mongo connection). Prefer sharing the client from server.py to avoid two pools.
/api/integration/push-analyses requires a Pydantic body — good — but there is no 404 when athlete_id is unknown; returns pushed:false with external_id:null silently. Consider 404 for clarity.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_additions.py (new — covers athlete.external_id + integration layer no-op endpoints)
seed_data_creation: Backend seed runs at startup (fundamentos, classificacoes, athletes, equipes AVA, 8 categorias, 6 formacoes, demo videos & actions). UI test created athlete TEST_UI_Atleta_* with external_id=UI-EXT-001 (not cleaned up — safe TEST_ prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All CRUD + AI + integration endpoints green. Additive features (athlete.external_id, /api/integration/*) covered by test_additions.py. Known cosmetic: Recharts width/height warnings on Reports when chart tab mounts hidden. Analyze testids: quick-{fund_id}, save-action, point-nos, point-adv, set-select, team-nos/adv, fund-/class-/mark-athlete- prefixes.
